design_acceptance: Existing owned canonical devai ancestor with no group/world write matches actual qualified context directory(path,false); private reconciliation leaf exact0700 and newdirectories0700 remain mandatory. No chmod or normalization of existing entries.

First seed stage and second issuer stage each require their own fresh typed provision receipt and exact confirmation. First review cannot assert future inode identity; second review freezes actual precursor identities and exact whole issuer bytes after existence.

In-lock metadata-only anchor use and lower-primitive exclusive descriptor ownership are consistent. Resume fsync of exact precursor must finish before native connection. No raw anchor read/open/close through namespace or helper callbacks while admission lives.
Issuer raw digest includes canonical signed JCS+LF; acyclic seed/provision_context/issuer/secondREADY graph matches frozen codec. Private key/key digest/MAC/bytes stay private.

Existing complete issuer preserves original installationB5/HEAD observations; fresh invocation B5/HEAD may differ. No implicit rotation/migration or grant authority follows existing issuer recognition.

Preexisting closed approval namespace must authenticate records with the admitted issuer key and exact names/IDs; it is neither blindly ignored nor deleted. Unknown/remnant entries refuse and survive.

Darwin type26 runtime envelope is explicit and narrow. Actual readonly statfs observation agrees for development and temporary roots; this is not generic filesystem, Linux, installedpackage or finaladapter qualification.
Review handle exact member/this/ALS custody, terminal wrongtoken/cancel/expiry/drift and safe error projection preserve opaque operation and qualified ns dual-clock contracts.
implementation_review_requirements: Verify namespace inspection never invokes raw anchor reader inside admission and no helper opens/closes admission.sqlite while locked; preserve lower SQL/metadata ownership.

Verify fresh context recapture after the first authorized namespace creation rather than retaining an expected-to-be-stale precreation context; recheck frozen currentHEAD/B5/clock and exact planned successor state.
Verify actual durable0600 seed/issuer create-only publication, exact precursor fsync before admission, fsync newly created dirs and parents, owned post-entry uncertainty and no retry/key rotation.
Verify exact two separate operation receipts, fixed private callbacks only, no raw native cause/key/payload/physical path in public values/errors.
Verify closed bounded preexisting approvals census and MAC/name/root/seed/identity binding without comparing immutable installationHEAD/B5 to fresh action observations.
Independent actual direct/linked contention/crash/durability tests and full historical suite remain separate Inspector gate.
